subject: Joint marketplace co-sell demo — CloudForge + AWS + SI runbook
messages:
From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@cloudforge.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@aws-partner.com>, ravi.menon@nebula-sys.com
Date: 2026-11-18T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Intro + joint marketplace demo — next steps

Hi Aditya / Camila —

Thanks for the quick sync last week. CloudForge is keen to do a joint marketplace co-sell demo that covers: a brief customer story, a walkthrough of the CloudForge listing, and a short end-to-end live demo (Redwood inference + CloudForge connector + AWS marketplace procurement flow). Wed like the SI (Nebula) there for any architecture Qs.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Nov 23: 10:00am - 11:00am
- Tue Nov 23: 2:00pm - 3:00pm
- Wed Nov 24: 9:00am - 10:00am

Can you confirm who from Redwood should be on the call and whether the second slot works? Also flag any prep items (service accounts, test account links). I can pull together a short public-facing slide deck and will attach a draft agenda.

Regards,
Sam Turner
Head of Partnerships, CloudForge
[Attachment: CF-JointDemo-Agenda-v0.2.pdf]

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@cloudforge.com>, camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@aws-partner.com>, ravi.menon@nebula-sys.com, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + joint marketplace demo — next steps

Thanks Sam —

We can cover the runtime integration, pricing-friendly config recommendations, and a short Q&A for the SI. Confirming Redwood attendees: myself (product/partnerships), Camila (solutions eng), Karthik (runtime lead). Hannah can join for marketplace operational questions if needed.

Im good for Tue Nov 23 2:00pm PST. Quick asks before the run-through:
- Can CloudForge share a sandbox AWS account or a pre-provisioned procurement test flow (marketplace test listing)?
- Any specific billing/procurement slides you want emphasized for marketplace ops?
- Ravi (Nebula), can you confirm the architecture diagram and whether you need us to provision test keys?

Im attaching a short draft agenda and a suggested pre-demo checklist (internal). Ill put a calendar invite once we lock the time.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: Redwood-pre-demo-checklist.xlsx]

From: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@cloudforge.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@aws-partner.com>, ravi.menon@nebula-sys.com, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T09:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + joint marketplace demo — next steps

+1 on Tue Nov 23 2pm PST. Ill run the demo flow and handle the CLI/service-account pieces. A couple notes:
- Please include a short customer use case slide (2 slides max) so we have a clear story to demo against.
- If you have a pre-provisioned CloudForge test listing, send the link; otherwise we can point to a mocked procurement flow.
- Ive added a quick pre-demo checklist row called "SI test credentials" in the attached workbook.

Hannah, if you can confirm the marketplace ops owner and whether we need a doc for the procurement playbook, that would be great.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Turner <sam.turner@cloudforge.com>, ravi.menon@nebula-sys.com, Elena Park <elena.park@aws-partner.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + joint marketplace demo — next steps

Quick technical checklist from my side:
- Well need a sample workload (small dataset + prompt set) to run during the live demo. If CloudForge can share a link or S3 path with read-only access, thatd save time.
- Please confirm expected sequence length and typical concurrency we should simulate (helps pick batching/quant profiles).
- For the marketplace procurement flow, confirm if you want us to demonstrate the private deploy + purchase flow or just the hosted API + marketplace link. Both are doable but require different prep.

Ravi: can Nebula confirm whether any network VPN or VPC peering is required for the live demo? If so well need an orchestration check 48h prior.

-Karthik
Lead, Serving Runtime, Redwood Inference

From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@cloudforge.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Intro + joint marketplace demo — next steps

Great, locking Tue Nov 23 2:00pm PST.

Actions:
- Ill send the sandbox S3 path and a short procurement test flow by EOD today.
- Attaching calendar invite (ICS) and updated agenda with time allocations.
- Ravi confirms no VPN needed; Nebula will supply a small test token for the connector.

See you all Tuesday — please accept the calendar invite: https://cal.example.com/meet/CF-Redwood-demo

Thanks,
Sam
Head of Partnerships, CloudForge
